newsitem.title: USA: MTV Latin America to use billboards.
newsitem.headline: MTV Latin America to use billboards.

text.p: MTV Latin America, a unit of Viacom Inc, said on Wednesday it would use billboard advertising for the first time in a promotional campaign in Argentina.
The country is the Miami-based television service's single largest market and would see a mix of international and domestic music stars on the billboards, MTV Latin America said in a news release.
Sixty or more billboards will be put up in Buenos Aires, Mar del Plata, Pinamal and Villa Gesell, MTV said. (( -- Miami newsroom, 305-374-5013 ))
